g.text: 3 All centered vectors start at the origin
Centering removes the component along the all-ones line
Eight illustrative features A–H. A fixed color follows the same feature throughout; the plane is H: x₁ + x₂ + x₃ = 0.
Dashed segment: residual from projection foot to tip.
No rotation; same arrow, translated by −p_A.
Centering also projects the original endpoint onto H.
